newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea intervenes to support won vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea intervenes to support won vs dollar.

text.p: The Bank of Korea intervened in early Monday morning trade, offering to sell dollars at 899.00 won in three-month forward trading, and 913.00 in six-month forward trading, dealers said.
Dealers said the dollar had been rising due to the nation's widening trade deficit.
The won opened at 886.00 and fell to 886.60 by 0110 GMT. It touched a low of 887.00.
Dealers said the central bank offered to sell about $300 million for three-month forward trading and all the amount was contracted immediately.
